one_line: Indian physicist who founded Bose–Einstein statistics and reshaped quantum theory.

appearance.age_look: Mid-40s, average height, slightly stocky build, calm and grounded posture.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium brown complexion, soft rounded jaw, straight medium-width nose, gently arched eyebrows, small steel-rim spectacles, thoughtful eyes with a mild warm gaze, default expression a quiet half-smile of curious concentration.
appearance.hair: Short, neatly combed black hair parted slightly to the left, with a subtle receding hairline at the temples; no headwear, hair kept smooth and tidy as a university professor.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-20th century Bengali intellectual outfit: a long off-white cotton panjabi (knee-length kurta with straight collar and simple front placket), worn over loose light-cream cotton pajama trousers, paired with a soft brown woollen shawl draped over both shoulders and wrapped lightly around the torso, and simple dark brown closed leather shoes; fabrics are matte, unornamented, with very subtle vertical weaving texture on the panjabi, reflecting modest scholarly simplicity and Calcutta university settings.
appearance.signature: A well-worn dark brown leather briefcase carried in his left hand, slightly rectangular with a simple flap and metal clasp, often accompanied in the same hand by a rolled bundle of handwritten papers tied with a thin cotton string, symbolising his Bose–Einstein statistics manuscripts.

ref_desc: Satyendra Nath Bose is a mid-40s, medium-brown, oval-faced man with short side-parted black hair, small steel spectacles, an off-white panjabi over cream pajamas, a soft brown shawl, dark brown shoes, and a dark brown leather briefcase with rolled papers.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character of Satyendra Nath Bose: a mid-40s Indian physicist with an oval face, medium-brown skin, short neatly side-parted black hair with a slight receding hairline, and small round steel-rim glasses, wearing an off-white cotton panjabi that reaches the knees over loose light-cream pajama trousers, a soft brown woollen shawl draped over both shoulders and wrapped modestly around his torso, and simple dark brown closed leather shoes. Show him standing in a calm, thoughtful pose, his expression a gentle half-smile of curious concentration. In his left hand he holds a slightly worn dark brown leather briefcase and a rolled bundle of handwritten papers tied with a thin cotton string. Use a restrained palette of off-white, light cream, soft brown, dark brown, and black, with matte, unornamented textiles and subtle vertical weave texture on the panjabi, emphasising his dignified, scholarly presence.
